d:
Daybitiz, jisse pirit kaee log hamen apne aas pas mil jaenge. vishv svasthy sangthan ke mutabik duniya men philhal 83 karor log daybitiz se pareshan hain. daybitiz asal men kya hai, iska pata kaise chalta hai, kya bina blad test kie bhi daybitiz ka pata lagaya ja sakta hai, daybitiz hone se hamare sharir par kya asar parta hai aur sabse aham bat daybitiz ko kantrol kaise kar sakte hain? in tamam savalon ke javab janne ke lie bibisi hindi ke editar nitin shrivastav ne bat ki dilli ke jitibi aspatal men medisin aur endrokrinoloji ke hed do. es vi madhu se.
Editing mohammad ibrahim
